title: The purpose of the path
summary: What the murshids want for the murid, and the stations Hazrat names along the way: tawbah, taqwa, tawakkul, sabr, tasleem, raza, fana and baqa.

blocks.p: Every way of tasawwuf looks different from outside. Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. says that underneath, they all want the same thing.

blocks.q: All the murshids have the same goal: to keep the murid pure, and on the way of the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.p: Right after this, Hazrat names the order of the path for the murid:

blocks.q: For the murid, first there is Taqwa, then Tawakkul, then Sabr, then Tasleem and Raza. And after the nafs comes Fana: fana of the self, then in the Attributes, then in the Essence, and at last Baqa.

blocks.p: The book Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara follows this order, and it starts with repentance. Hazrat reads that a person who wants to walk the path of Allah first regrets his past negligence and wrongdoing, and asks Allah's forgiveness. He also reads that 'Taqwa begins with repentance'.

blocks.q: When a person wants to walk the path of Allah, he first regrets his past negligence and wrongdoing, and asks Allah's forgiveness.

blocks.p: In the dars on Bai'at, Hazrat explains what a true guide does for you:

blocks.q: The one who frees you from bondage to everything else, his company is necessary. If he turns your thoughts towards Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, that is the real thing.

blocks.p: Hazrat warns that there is no short cut. Reading from the book, he says that when the nafs is truly refined, a person is given fana-e-af'aal, the effacement of his own acts, and then he sees no benefit or harm coming from anyone but Allah. Without refining the nafs, every claim of fana is 'words without meaning'.

blocks.q: There is only one straight path, and it is shorter than all the others. Whoever is on the straight path reaches the destination faster.

blocks.p: And the test does not end. Hazrat says: do not think that once you have passed the exam you are free. As long as you are alive, the exam goes on. So keep asking Allah's forgiveness, and keep praying to be saved from the nafs and Shaytan.

blocks.note: Hazrat names fana in the Attributes, fana in the Essence and baqa, but these dars do not explain them. Ask your teacher.

ru.title: Tareeqat ka maqsad
ru.summary: Murshid murid ke liye kya chahte hain, aur raaste ke woh maqaamaat jo Hazrat ginwaate hain: tauba, taqwa, tawakkul, sabr, tasleem, raza, fana aur baqa.

blocks.p: Tasawwuf ka har tareeqa baahar se alag dikhta hai. Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. farmate hain ke andar se sab ek hi cheez chahte hain.

blocks.q: Sab murshidon ka ek hi maqsad hai: murid ko paak rakhna, aur Huzoor ﷺ ke raaste par rakhna.

blocks.p: Iske fauran baad Hazrat murid ke liye raaste ki tarteeb batate hain:

blocks.q: Murid ke liye pehle Taqwa hai, phir Tawakkul, phir Sabr, phir Tasleem aur Raza. Aur nafs ke baad Fana aati hai: pehle apne aap ki fana, phir Sifaat mein, phir Zaat mein, aur aakhir mein Baqa.

blocks.p: Kitaab Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara isi tarteeb par chalti hai, aur tauba se shuru hoti hai. Hazrat padhte hain ke jo aadmi Allah ke raaste par chalna chahta hai woh pehle apni pichhli ghaflat aur ghaltiyon par sharminda hota hai, aur Allah se maafi maangta hai. Woh yeh bhi padhte hain ke 'Taqwa tauba se shuru hota hai'.

blocks.q: Jab aadmi Allah ke raaste par chalna chahta hai to woh pehle apni pichhli ghaflat aur ghaltiyon par sharminda hota hai, aur Allah se maafi maangta hai.

blocks.p: Bai'at ke dars mein Hazrat samjhaate hain ke ek sachcha rehnuma aapke liye kya karta hai:

blocks.q: Jo aapko har doosri cheez ki ghulaami se aazaad kar de, uski sohbat zaroori hai. Agar woh aapke khayal ko Allah aur Uske Rasool ﷺ ki taraf mod de, to yahi asal cheez hai.

blocks.p: Hazrat khabardaar karte hain ke koi shortcut nahin hai. Kitaab se padhte hue woh farmate hain ke jab nafs ki sahi islaah ho jaati hai to aadmi ko fana-e-af'aal ata hoti hai, yaani apne afaal ka mit jaana, aur phir usko Allah ke siwa kisi se nafa ya nuqsaan aata nazar nahin aata. Nafs ki islaah ke baghair fana ka har daawa 'be-maani alfaaz' hai.

blocks.q: Seedha raasta sirf ek hai, aur woh baaqi sab raaston se chhota hai. Jo seedhe raaste par hai woh manzil par jaldi pahunchta hai.

blocks.p: Aur imtihaan khatam nahin hota. Hazrat farmate hain: yeh mat socho ke ek baar imtihaan paas kar liya to aazaad ho gaye. Jab tak zinda ho, imtihaan chalta rehta hai. Isliye Allah se maafi maangte raho, aur nafs aur Shaitaan se bachne ki dua karte raho.

blocks.note: Hazrat Sifaat mein fana, Zaat mein fana aur baqa ka naam lete hain, lekin in dars mein inki tashreeh nahin hai. Apne ustaad se poochiye.
